readout_other: STN and M1 LFP (theta/beta power, PAC, STN-M1 correlation); M1 single-unit firing; open field; rotarod; histology for tissue damage
direction_notes: STN-targeted TUS reduced theta and beta power and theta-beta PAC in STN and M1, lowered STN-M1 LFP correlation and M1 firing rates, and improved open-field and rotarod performance; the effect after 7 days persisted to Day 14 and weakened over time.
safety_notes: Histological analysis 7 days after stimulation with the same parameters showed no tissue damage in the STN or adjacent regions; temperature rise calculated as about 0.02 C.

timing.protocol_description: 500 kHz, PRF 1 kHz, duty cycle 5%, 'stimulation duration' 50 ms, total stimulation time 30 min per session, under 0.6% isoflurane. One session before testing on Day 1 (part 1) or 30 min on 7 consecutive days with testing on Days 7 and 14 (part 2).

source_quotes.n_subjects: Each group had 8 animals in the first part and 10 animals in the second part.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The experiments were divided into two parts: one with a single-day TUS and the other with a consecutive 7-day TUS.
